ICS 59.080.99TXD 35New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPE1.1 This standard prescribes constructional particulars and performance requirements for flexible water storage tanks for storage of rain water, especially in hilly areas for agriculture and horticulture purposes.1.2 These tanks may also be used for storage of water for other domestic and commercial applications except drinking water applications.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
